```{r}
source("feature_engineering_functions.R")
training_data <- readRDS("training_data.rds")

X24_25 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/24_25.csv")
X25_26 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/25_26.csv")

X25_26_training <- build_season_dataset(
  current_data = X25_26,
  previous_data = X24_25,
  season_label = "2025/26",
  0.15
)
poisson_formula <- Goals ~ DSTF + TeamRankCategory + HomeAway + opp_defence_score + 
    attack_score + DCS + OpponentRankCategory + DYF + DSF + DLF
```

```{r}
# Train on all seasons before 2025/26
poisson_model_final <- glm(
  poisson_formula,
  data = training_data,
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

# Predict goals for each team in 2025/26
X25_26_training <- X25_26_training %>%
  mutate(
    predicted_goals = predict(
      poisson_model_final,
      newdata = X25_26_training,
      type = "response"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
match_predictions_25_26 <- X25_26_training %>%
  select(
    Year, match_id, HomeAway, Team, Goals, predicted_goals
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = HomeAway,
    values_from = c(Team, Goals, predicted_goals)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    goal_difference =
      predicted_goals_Home - predicted_goals_Away,

    predicted_result = case_when(
      abs(goal_difference) <= 0.25 ~ "D",
      goal_difference > 0.25 ~ "H",
      TRUE ~ "A"
    ),

    actual_result = case_when(
      Goals_Home > Goals_Away ~ "H",
      Goals_Home < Goals_Away ~ "A",
      TRUE ~ "D"
    ),

    predicted_home_points = case_when(
      predicted_result == "H" ~ 3,
      predicted_result == "D" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    predicted_away_points = case_when(
      predicted_result == "A" ~ 3,
      predicted_result == "D" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    actual_home_points = case_when(
      actual_result == "H" ~ 3,
      actual_result == "D" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    actual_away_points = case_when(
      actual_result == "A" ~ 3,
      actual_result == "D" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )
```

```{r}
points_by_team_match <- bind_rows(
  match_predictions_25_26 %>%
    transmute(
      Year, match_id,
      Team = Team_Home,
      HomeAway = "Home",
      points_gained = actual_home_points,
      predicted_points = predicted_home_points
    ),

  match_predictions_25_26 %>%
    transmute(
      Year, match_id,
      Team = Team_Away,
      HomeAway = "Away",
      points_gained = actual_away_points,
      predicted_points = predicted_away_points
    )
)

X25_26_training <- X25_26_training %>%
  left_join(
    points_by_team_match,
    by = c("Year", "match_id", "Team", "HomeAway")
  )
```

```{r}
league_table_25_26 <- X25_26_training %>%
  group_by(Team) %>%
  summarise(
    PredictedPoints = sum(predicted_points, na.rm = TRUE),
    ActualPoints = sum(points_gained, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(PredictedPoints)) %>%
  mutate(
    PredictedRank = row_number()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(ActualPoints)) %>%
  mutate(
    ActualRank = row_number()
  )

league_table_25_26
```
```{r}
pm <- function(predicted, actual) {
  wt <- c()

  for (i in 1:length(predicted)) {
    p <- predicted[i]  # predicted position
    a <- actual[i]     # actual position
    d <- abs(p - a)    # distance between predicted and actual i.e. residual

    if (a <= 5) {  # team actually finished in the top five

      if (p == a) { # actual and predicted teams are in the same position within the first 5
        w <- 1
      } else if (p <= 5) { # actual and predicted teams aren't in the same position but are within the first 5
        w <- 0.7
      } else if (d <= 2) { # actual and predicted teams aren't in the same position but predicted are 1 or 2 spaces from actual
        w <- 0.4
      } else { # predicted takes values in position 8+ while predicted takes position within first 5
        w <- -(d / 19) #  i.e. for each position further apart, then the weight becomes smaller
      }

    } else {  # team actually finished outside the top five

      if (p <= 5) { # incorrectly predicted in the top five
        w <- 0  
      } else if (p == a) { # correctly predicted outside of top 5
        w <- 0.4
      } else { # incorrectly predicted outside of top 5
        w <- -(d / 14) # notice for one space wrong w = -0.07, for 14 spaces wrong (max distance) w = -1
      }
    }

    wt <- c(wt, w)
  }

  sum(wt) 
}
pm(predicted = league_table_25_26$PredictedRank, actual = league_table_25_26$ActualRank)
```
